title: Build the test-run registration confirmation projection from a typed borrowed Serialize struct
outcome: The registration view's field names come from one serde definition tied to TestRunSummary, so renaming a summary field cannot silently drift the projection.
acceptance: src/test_run_registration_query.rs builds the registration confirmation projection with a borrowed #[derive(Serialize)] struct (serde rename_all camelCase or shared field attributes) instead of a hand-written json! object, keeping the same 11 identity fields plus source and the same encoded output; the existing bounded-view behavioural test that compares every key with the full detail still passes.
